definitions.explanation: A shop that sells ready-made dishes and side dishes for takeout. These stores typically offer a variety of cooked foods such as fried items, salads, simmered dishes, and rice balls.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{総菜屋|そうざいや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I shopped at the deli in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{総菜屋|そうざいや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コロッケ→コロッケ：10857_korokke⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The croquettes at that deli are very popular.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{総菜屋|そうざいや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{夕飯|ゆうはん}→夕飯：02981_yuuhan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかず→おかず：08272_okazu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: On busy days, I often buy side dishes for dinner at the deli on my way home.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{総菜|そうざい}→総菜：16739_souzai⟧ (side dishes, prepared food) + ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (shop/store). Refers to shops specializing in ready-made dishes for takeout.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総菜屋|そうざいや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy at a deli
- ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{総菜屋|そうざいや}: neighborhood deli
- ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧{総菜屋|そうざいや}: handmade-food shop

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditional {総菜屋|そうざいや} have long been a staple of Japanese neighborhoods, offering affordable home-style cooking. While supermarket deli sections (⟦{惣菜|そうざい}→惣菜：05827_souzai⟧⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧) and convenience stores have taken over much of this role, independent {総菜屋|そうざいや} remain popular for their quality and personal touch.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}→惣菜：05827_souzai⟧: the prepared food itself ({惣|そう} and ⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧ are variant kanji)
- ⟦{弁当屋|べんとうや}→弁当屋：28445_bentouya⟧: boxed-lunch shop
